edge +1.0% below the 4% minimum (starting goalie unconfirmed)

evidence: log loss +0.0139 (95% interval +0.0031 to +0.0238). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

179 picks, ROI -0.6% (95% interval -12.7% to +10.5%), win rate 59.2% against a break-even 58.9%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 28% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.07 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,886 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,759; a 1% edge takes 43,973. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
